description: This file contains CMake functions to parse JSON strings into CMake variables and handle escape sequences. It provides utility functions for converting JSON-encoded strings into usable CMake strings with proper escaping and formatting.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a CMake string, handling escape sequences and quotes.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: References a JSON string variable and converts its content into a CMake string using json_string_to_cmake.
